WHERE i.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND ( UPPER(i.ITEM_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{criteria.keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(i.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{criteria.keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, SPECIFICATION, UNIT, OUTBOUND_PRICE, STOCK_QUANTITY, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_item.* FROM ( SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_CODE, i.ITEM_NAME, i.SPECIFICATION, i.UNIT, i.OUTBOUND_PRICE, i.ACTIVE_FLAG,
NVL(s.QUANTITY, 0) CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)
AS STOCK_QUANTITY FROM ITEM i
LEFT JOIN STOCK s ON s.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND s.WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId}
ORDER BY i.ITEM_CODE ASC ) ordered_item WHERE ROWNUM <= #{criteria.pageNum} * #{criteria.amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{criteria.pageNum} - 1) * #{criteria.amount} ORDER BY ITEM_CODE ASC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, SPECIFICATION, UNIT, OUTBOUND_PRICE, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS STOCK_QUANTITY, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ITEM WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
